parameters.name: NewResourceGroupId
parameters.description:
The ID of the resource group to which you want to transfer the cloud resource instance.

> A resource group is a mechanism for managing resources by group within an Alibaba Cloud account. Resource groups help you resolve complex issues such as resource grouping and authorization management within a single cloud account. For more information, see [What is Resource Management](~~94475~~).

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the resource.

parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the resource that you want to tag. Only instance-level resources are supported.

Example: If the instance ID is alikafka_post-cn-v0h1fgs2xxxx, the resource ID is alikafka_post-cn-v0h1fgs2xxxx.
